blocks.text: This Christmas, SM Supermalls takes the celebrations to the max with 12 Weeks of Iconic Christmas at SM, bringing festive experiences to malls across the Philippines. From magical installations and exciting activities to core memory-making moments with loved ones, the nationwide celebration invites Cebuanos to gala to the max and make the most of the holiday season at their most-loved SM Seaside City Cebu. Now in its fifth week, 12 Weeks of Iconic Christmas continues at SM Seaside City Cebu with the Skypark Christmas Illumination, an aurora-inspired light show that brings vibrant waves of color to The Skypark.
